text:
Situation: Droperidol 2.5 mg/mL 2 mL single-dose vials are low at both campuses. Corvale East has 62 vials on hand, covering 9.1 days. Corvale General has 113.35 vials on hand, covering 13.3 days. The product label lists Hikma Farmaceutica (Portugal) S.A. as the manufacturing plant.

Why (FDA record): FDA inspection 876911 of the Hikma plant ended 2014-03-28 and was classified Official Action Indicated with six observations, including absence of written procedures and deviations from laboratory control requirements. A Warning Letter was issued to the plant on 2014-10-21. Subsequent inspections in 2015, 2016, 2020, and 2023 were classified Voluntary Action Indicated. Droperidol is not on the FDA drug shortage list as of 2026-10-21.

Our position: Current inventory is insufficient to sustain operations beyond two weeks. The Hikma plant has a history of OAI classification and a Warning Letter, though recent inspections have been VAI. An alternative supplier with acceptable inspection history is available and not on the FDA shortage list.

Recommended actions:
1. Buyer initiates purchase of droperidol from American Regent, Inc.; requires Pharmacy Director approval.
2. Buyer verifies American Regent supply continuity and lead time; requires Supply Chain Manager approval.
3. Pharmacy Director allocates received stock to Corvale East and Corvale General based on usage rates; requires P&T Committee notification.

Not recommended: Delaying procurement pending Hikma plant status changes; splitting current inventory between campuses without a replenishment plan.
